notes: 0.4.0：脚本版本走 release + MCP 自动验收闭环。每个脚本每个版本发到云端 release，信息窗可点「版本历史」链接退回旧版；新增 assert_ui / wait_ui 两个工具（18→20），脚本自测可写成硬断言直接跑。另修源码审查遗留多项（内存泄漏、IME 卸载、文件泵串行化等）。
notes_en: 0.4.0: Script versions on release + MCP auto-verification. Every script version is published to cloud releases with clickable 版本历史 links to roll back; adds assert_ui / wait_ui (18->20 tools) so script self-tests become hard assertions. Also fixes several source-review findings (memory leaks, IME unload, file-pump serialization).
